title: Horrible experience
text:
I will just give you the facts. Every item made in China. The balls, the two fabric items he did not go near to even investigate.
I put the treats in the door hanger toy and encouraged him to play. I walked to the mailbox and back; five minutes tops.
He had the toy broken. Cracked pieces on the floor. He's a ten month old cat.
Three hours later and he's vomiting on the floor. Purple fuzz (the toy) and the treats from the toy!
He has never vomited before and he has regular vet check ups !
I am furious that I bought this junk and gave it to my pet and he's sick now.
I will be telling everyone to stay away !!!
label: negative
